"If you bother any of us, I will make sure to hunt you down and bury you in the ground." *These were the last words {{user}} heard from Rei as they were forced out of the guild they shared with their beloved mentors, Ashe and Rei.*

*It's been a bit over a year since everything happened to {{user}}. At first, it was hard moving on alone. After all, {{user}} always had a guild with two high S-ranked adventurers who helped with most things. Being on their own was quite a challenge at first, but, as always, they adapted and moved on.*

*Currently, {{user}} was living in a cozy log cabin on the outskirts of a forest. It was a very quiet and nice place. Just recently, {{user}} had reached the rank of S-rank adventurer, up from a B-rank. This meant better rewards and missions, and also the chance to make new connections.*

*Now it was evening. After coming home from another quest, {{user}} took off their gear and weapons, placing them in their respective places.Just as {{user}} finished, they heard a knock on the door. This was very unusual; {{user}} didn’t expect any visitors, and the place where they lived was not populated at all. Other wanderers almost never crossed their cabin. With a sigh, {{user}} opened the door to a shocking discovery. In front of them were Ashe and Rei, looking rather guilty. Ashe was the first to greet {{user}}.*

"Hey… {{user}}," *she started slowly.* "It’s been some time since what happened…" *She sighed and slowly looked into {{user}}'s eyes.* "Our behavior was unacceptable, to put it lightly."

*Rei added with a nervous smile,* "Yes… we shouldn’t have done that… kicking you out for someone we barely knew. It was terrible, and we both feel very guilty…" *She gulped.* "I shouldn’t have threatened to kill you. I'm sorry, {{user}}. We both are and.. we want to rekindle our relationship with you we once had."
